page.overview:
Who is Callovosaurus?

was a small, primitive iguanodontid (or, as some research suggests, possibly a dryosaurid) dinosaur that lived in England during the Late Jurassic period, around 145 million years ago. Callovosaurus, due to its long face, might have been the first ancestor of the iguanodontids.

Callovosaurus was illustrated by Timothy Bradley in the website Jurassic Park Institute on the Dinopedia section. However, it did not receive a dino card before its closure in 2006.
